products.name: Indri Trini Single Malt
products.tastingNotes: Matured in Ex-Bourbon, Ex-Wine, and PX Sherry casks in Indri, Haryana. Notes of caramelized pineapple, vanilla, black tea, and sweet raisins.

products.name: Amrut Fusion Single Malt
products.tastingNotes: Distilled from a fusion of Indian six-row barley and peated Scottish barley. Rich oak, dark chocolate fudge, and warm peat smoke.

products.name: Rampur Double Cask Single Malt
products.tastingNotes: Handcrafted in the Himalayan foothills using American Bourbon barrels and European Oak Sherry casks. Tropical fruit and spiced oak.

products.name: GianChand Single Malt Whisky
products.tastingNotes: Crafted in Jammu with pristine Himalayan water. Delicate pineapple candy drop sweetness, vanilla backbone, and subtle barley oil.

products.name: Glenfiddich 12 YO Single Malt
products.tastingNotes: Matured in Oloroso sherry and bourbon oak casks for 12 years. Fresh pear, butterscotch, cream, and subtle oak.

products.name: The Glenlivet 12 YO Double Oak
products.tastingNotes: Smooth floral aroma with bright summer citrus, roasted hazelnut, and sweet vanilla custard.

products.name: The Macallan Double Cask 12 YO
products.tastingNotes: Harmonious marriage of American and European Oloroso sherry-seasoned oak casks. Honeyed ginger, citrus marmalade, and sultanas.

products.name: Talisker 10 YO Single Malt
products.tastingNotes: Made by the sea on the Isle of Skye. Powerful coastal sea-salt spray, cracked black pepper, and sweet orchard smoke.

products.name: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 YO
products.tastingNotes: Iconic 12-year aged blend of whiskies from all four corners of Scotland bursting with dark fruits, sweet vanilla, and signature peat smoke.

products.name: Monkey Shoulder Blended Malt
products.tastingNotes: Small-batch blend of prized Speyside single malts matured in first-fill ex-Bourbon barrels. Zesty orange, mellow vanilla, and spiced oak.

products.name: Chivas Regal 12 YO
products.tastingNotes: Cask-matured Speyside richness with wild herbs, heather honey, creamy butterscotch, and orchard apples.

products.name: Ballantine's Finest Blended Scotch
products.tastingNotes: Refined, balanced blend with light heather honey, milk chocolate, red apple, and vanilla finish.

products.name: Jameson Triple Distilled Irish Whiskey
products.tastingNotes: Triple-distilled Irish pot still and fine grain whiskey. Light floral fragrance peppered with spicy wood and sweet sherry nuttiness.

products.name: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee
products.tastingNotes: Mellowed drop by drop through 10 feet of sugar maple charcoal. Smooth caramel, toasted oak, banana, and smoky vanilla.

products.name: Jim Beam Kentucky Straight Bourbon
products.tastingNotes: Aged 4 years in newly charred American white oak barrels. Oaky vanilla aroma with medium-bodied caramel and sweet corn warmth.

products.name: Maker's Mark Handmade Bourbon
products.tastingNotes: Crafted with soft red winter wheat instead of rye for a zero-bitterness palate bursting with butterscotch, woody oak, and vanilla.

products.name: Greater Than London Dry Gin
products.tastingNotes: Distilled in a copper pot still in Goa with 9 botanicals including juniper, lemongrass, ginger, and chamomile. Clean citrus zing.

products.name: Stranger & Sons Indian Spirited Gin
products.tastingNotes: Bold botanical chorus of Gondhoraj limes, Nagpur oranges, nimble limes, black pepper, nutmeg, and coriander seed.

products.name: Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin
products.tastingNotes: Infused with 11 botanicals including Darjeeling green tea leaves, vetiver, sweet orange peel, cubeb berries, and lemongrass.

products.name: Hendrick's Scottish Small Batch Gin
products.tastingNotes: Unusual distillation in Bennett and Carter-Head stills infused with Bulgarian Rosa Damascena petals and refreshing cucumber.

products.name: Corona Extra Mexican Pint
products.tastingNotes: Crisp, sun-drenched pale lager with light honey-malt sweetness and refreshing hop character.

products.name: Hoegaarden Witbier Pint
products.tastingNotes: Unfiltered Belgian white beer brewed with Curaçao orange peel and coriander seeds for a velvety, cloud-like citrus finish.

products.name: Bira 91 White Ale Can
products.tastingNotes: Deliciously cloudy wheat ale with low bitterness, bright orange peel aroma, and a touch of Indian coriander.

products.name: Budweiser Magnum Strong Bottle
products.tastingNotes: Beechwood-aged strong super premium lager with roasted malt sweetness and crisp herbal hop balance.

products.name: Kingfisher Ultra Smooth Lager
products.tastingNotes: Brewed from the finest imported malts and hops for a golden appearance and exceptionally crisp, smooth taste.

products.name: Grey Goose French Vodka
products.tastingNotes: Distilled from soft winter wheat from Picardie and Gensac spring water. Creamy almond pastry notes and a silky, clean finish.

products.name: Absolut Original Swedish Vodka
products.tastingNotes: Continuous distillation using winter wheat and deep well water in Åhus. Rich, full-bodied grain character with dried fruit hints.

products.name: Old Monk The Legend Dark Rum
products.tastingNotes: Iconic monk-head decanter filled with vatted dark Indian rum bursting with roasted coffee, dark caramel, vanilla, and jaggery.

products.name: Bacardí Carta Blanca Superior White Rum
products.tastingNotes: Aged in American white oak barrels and shaped through a secret blend of charcoal for floral, vanilla, and citrus cocktail perfection.

products.name: Patrón Silver 100% Blue Weber Tequila
products.tastingNotes: Handcrafted from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave in Jalisco. Smooth roasted agave, bright citrus, and light white pepper.

products.name: Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut Champagne
products.tastingNotes: Vibrant intensity of green apple and citrus fruit, mineral freshness, white blossoms, and blonde brioche elegance.

products.name: Sula Dindori Reserve Shiraz
products.tastingNotes: Matured in American oak barrels for 12 months. Silky red berries, mocha, vanilla bean, and smoky black pepper.

products.name: Jacob's Creek Classic Chardonnay
products.tastingNotes: Ripe melon and white peach flavours layered with zesty lemon curd and subtle toasted oak creaminess.

wines.name: Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut
wines.notes: Green apple, citrus blossom & toasted brioche

wines.name: Sula Dindori Reserve Shiraz
wines.notes: Blackberry, dark mocha & American oak spice

wines.name: Château d'Esclans Whispering Angel
wines.notes: Dry summer berries, white peach & mineral finish

wines.name: Jacob's Creek Classic Chardonnay
wines.notes: Zesty lemon, ripe melon & creamy oak finish

cocktails.name: The Common Thread
ingredients: 60ml Vetiver-root infused Greater Than or Stranger & Sons Gin
cocktails.story: Created at Comorin Gurgaon by Chinmay Borah, this aromatic cocktail weaves earthy north-Indian khus (vetiver) root with botanical gin for a silky, nostalgic monsoon finish.

cocktails.name: Hemu's Highball
cocktails.story: Sahil Gaur elevates the classic whisky highball by pairing tropical roasted pineapple notes with three-wood Indian single malt and smoky cardamom.

cocktails.name: Mary Me Martini
ingredients: 60ml Grey Goose Vodka rested with sun-dried cherry tomatoes
3 drops Fresh Basil & Black Pepper oil
cocktails.story: Rohit Jana reimagines the savory Bloody Mary into a crystal-clear, razor-sharp martini bursting with umami richness and zero heaviness.

cocktails.name: The Highland Botanist
cocktails.glassware: Rocks Glass over Clear Ice Sphere
ingredients: 50ml Chivas Regal 12 YO or Johnnie Walker Black Label
cocktails.story: Featured at Ophelia Delhi, Rishabh Mehrotra bridges rugged Scottish heather honey notes with bright Mediterranean botanicals.

cocktails.name: Bilvananda
ingredients: 60ml Maker's Mark or Jim Beam Bourbon
cocktails.story: Souvik Rana celebrates forgotten Indian fruit by marrying caramel-rich Kentucky Bourbon with sacred roasted wood apple nectar.

cocktails.name: Albatross
ingredients: Top with Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut
cocktails.story: Designed for sun-drenched courtyard afternoons at Olive Qutub, Rajat Tolia pairs citrus-forward craft gin with crisp champagne.
